title: Example of evaluating a response surface optimal design - Minitab
steps: In the Example of selecting a D-optimal response surface design, a materials scientist selects a subset of 20 design points from a candidate set of 30 points.
In this example, the materials scientist wants to determine how reducing the model changes the optimality.
Remember that a model that is D-optimal for a given model only.
Choose Stat > DOE > Response Surface > Select Optimal Design.
Choose Evaluate design, then enter OptPoint in the box.
From the Include the following terms drop-down list, select Linear.
Click OK in each dialog box.
notes: Number of design points in optimal design: 20
Row number of selected design points: 1, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 10, 13, 15, 16, 17, 19, 22, 23, 24,
